text_block_list.text:
While out shopping for daily necessities 
with Yaeno Muteki, we came across a crowd 
in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Things seem quite lively here, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see, the lottery raffle, is it?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, folks! If you're on your way 
back from shopping, do you have any 
lottery tickets?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A lottery ticket... Ah, yes indeed. I have 
received it.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Then c'mon, over here!
choice_data_list:
You've got the chance, so go ahead and 
draw!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I hesitate to let the ticket go to 
waste. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell the truth, back in the day, I 
couldn't accept my lottery result, threw a 
fit, and destroyed the raffle machine."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I had been banned from my local lottery 
draw."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am unaccustomed to lotteries... Will I 
be able to remain unshaken by the 
outcome...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono. If it pleases you, I would 
be honored if you would pull alongside me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Now then—

Together with Yaeno Muteki, I slowly 
turned the handle of the raffle machine.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The grand prize...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —...Mmm... ...Humph.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —A stroke of luck.
choice_data_list: No, no, no! Shouldn't you be happier?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nay! Being swayed by one's emotions is 
proof of immaturity!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must remain calm at all times!!
choice_data_list: There's no need to hold back your joy!

text_block_list.text:
I explained that as long as she didn't 
cross the line, celebrating to her heart's 
content wouldn't cause trouble for anyone, 
so she should go for it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...D-Do you really think so...? Is it 
truly all right to openly express this 
thrilling excitement...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Together...! I-If that's the case...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Grand! Prize! Banzaiii!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, please feel free to use this 
"Hot Springs Voucher."
choice_data_list: Huh? But it's your raffle ticket...
Huh? But they're your raffle tickets...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Observing your gait, Trainer-dono, the 
movement in your neck, shoulders, and hips 
appears rather stiff.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps your muscles are stiff? I 
recommend hot spring therapy.

Just as Yaeno Muteki observed, my 
shoulders and back are definitely stiff. 
However, when I tell her that she must be 
tired too—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am in perfect health. Thanks to your 
guidance, Trainer, no fatigue has built 
up.
choice_data_list:
Still, taking time to refresh is important 
too.

Still, you need to take time to refresh 
too, you know?

text_block_list.text:
Taking time to refresh is especially 
important for stoic types like Yaeno 
Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, training at a hot spring has its 
own charm. A change of pace might do us 
good.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the travel vouchers seem to 
be for a pair, so let us do this.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Once things settle down, you and I could 
use this hot spring voucher. How does that 
sound, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for readily agreeing. In that 
case, I shall leave this ticket in 
Trainer-dono's care.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I'm looking forward to it.

We've added one more exciting promise to 
look forward to with Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...T-This carrot hamburg steak is...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's rice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's rice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have eaten this carrot hamburger steak 
before. It was sent to my family home as a 
year-end gift.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The deeply rich demiglace sauce goes 
wonderfully with rice! The entire rice tub 
emptied out in no time at all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Taking home only a Carrot Hamburger Steak 
cannot be considered fully prepared.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's buy some rice on our way back too!

Following Yaeno Muteki's strong 
recommendation, we ended up buying rice to 
bring home as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...*nom nom nom nom nom nom*.
choice_data_list: The rice... I can't stop eating it...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. The pure bliss brought by this 
premium carrot hamburg steak and rice is 
simply sublime...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A magnificent demi-glace sauce!

Thanks to Yaeno Muteki, I was able to 
savor the Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg 
Steak and rice to my heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Goodness, this much...?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There's no way this is an amount just two 
people can finish.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-dono, pardon me for asking 
something out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am rather unfamiliar with socializing 
between friends, so I was hoping you could 
offer me some advice...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Would it be impolite to bring carrot 
dishes as a gift for my classmates...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...! In that case, let's bring 
some refreshments to Chiyono O-san and 
Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Mmm, that was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san, thank you for the 'Carrot Set 
Meal'!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Every single dish was exquisite. In 
particular, I quite fancy the delicate 
seasoning of this carrot takikomi gohan.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...! I'm so glad it suits your taste.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Carrots are a highly nutritious 
vegetable... When I acquired a large 
quantity of them, your faces came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I know this may be presumptuous of me, but 
please forgive my selfishness in wanting 
to wait for both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Thank you very much. Fufufu, I am 
delighted.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! It's just like the proverb: 
"Salt for your enemies! Carrots for your 
rivals!" right?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……? ……I'm getting deja vu……

—Maxims aside, Yaeno Muteki seemed 
satisfied and pleased that her gift of 
carrot dishes was enjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Hmm. One carrot...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Let's go with pickles. They'll provide a 
good amount of sodium, making them the 
perfect snack for training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Pair it with rice balls, and it turns into 
a bento meal.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if I do say so myself, it's quite a 
clever idea.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With this level of freshness, 
quick-pickling is the way to go.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you would like, would you care for a 
taste as well, Trainer-dono? I shall bring 
some to training.

The next day, during a break in training, 
the two of us snacked on some lightly 
pickled carrots made by Yaeno Muteki. The 
perfectly balanced saltiness was 
exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
――...I see. So this is a trial for me, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Were you testing whether I could stay calm 
even in the face of an unacceptable 
outcome?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Whaah!? I-I had zero intention of doing 
that!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh, no need to hide it. It stems from my 
own unworthiness in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even with such a humiliating result, I 
shall endure without losing my composure!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Deep inhale*... *Deep exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Tissues...! A prize optimized for all 
mankind that will never go to waste...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Purely in terms of quantity, a 
single lottery ticket has multiplied into 
so many pieces of paper...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If this isn't a stroke of good fortune, I 
don't know what is! And after that...

Though she seemed somewhat flustered 
already... Yaeno Muteki managed to keep 
her composure, yet radiated frustration 
the entire time.
